method.classification: Post-hoc diagnosis only. The original fixed-sample result remains 21 deaths / 29 completed floors / neither 200 nor 400 reached. This exact replay is not another independent journey.
method.replay: Same unchanged original simulator with 400-floor target, 160000 decision budget and >20-death stop; shops/forge/fusion off, safe events, expected-score equipment, all earned points legally allocated to power.
method.continuation: Start from the complete natural dead terminal save; exactly one legal retry, then the pre-existing balanced/normal-spending journey policy for at most 12 finished combat attempts, first further death or 6000 decisions. Existing spent talent points are not reassigned. No enemy, HP, RNG, gold, item or route field is edited.
method.tail: The last 64 actual rolls are retained, including death attempts. Recovery/addition is derived from adjacent observed enemy HP/shield and the settled roll fields. A retry has no preceding comparison.

limits: A failed constrained policy is not proof of an engine-level continuation lock. The game legally supports retry and equipment changes; paid rooms cannot be opened from dead/combat.
The independent paid/balanced floor-one journeys for the same seed follow different earlier choices and RNG histories, so their success is not a same-state rescue result.
One post-hoc retry neither establishes an optimal rescue build nor changes the main fixed four-seed completion count.
